posts.title: Doom, compiled into a transformer
posts.description: No training anywhere: a compiler sets the weights of a stock Phi-3-architecture checkpoint so autoregressive generation executes Doom's classic renderer.

posts.title: A calculator, compiled into a transformer

posts.title: Introducing torchwright
posts.description: A compiler that turns computation graphs into the weights of a stock transformer -- no training anywhere. Where it came from and how it works.
